tray.background: Its icon is in the notification area. Choose Exit from its menu to stop it.

exit.title: Exit TinyTorrent?
exit.active: Transfers are still active. Exiting will stop them.

conflict.title: Exit the other TinyTorrent?
conflict.reason: It uses a different data folder. Force exit may lose unsaved changes.
conflict.exit_tip: Exit the other TinyTorrent, then open this one
conflict.waiting: Waiting for the other TinyTorrent to exit. If it asks you something, answer there.
conflict.running: The other TinyTorrent is still running. Check its window for a confirmation, or select Exit to try again.
conflict.refused: The other TinyTorrent didn't accept Exit.
conflict.failed: Windows couldn't end the other TinyTorrent. End it in Task Manager.

notification.location_torrents_one: {0} torrent cannot access its download location.
notification.location_torrents_other: {0} torrents cannot access their download location.
notification.unfinished: Moves, checks or deletions stopped when TinyTorrent closed. Select this to choose whether to continue them.
notification.missing_program: Torrents are set to open with a program that is missing: {0}. Select this to repair it in Settings.
notification.missing_programs: Torrents are set to open with programs that are missing: {0} and {1} more. Select this to repair them in Settings.
notification.off_finished: Don't notify when a download finishes
notification.off_added: Don't notify when a torrent is added
notification.off_background: Don't notify when the window closes
notification.retry_tip: Try to open the window again
notification.open_folder_tip: Open the folder that holds TinyTorrent's program files
notification.force_exit_tip: Exit now without saving the latest changes
notification.files_folder_tip: Open the folder that holds the files
notification.show_torrent_tip: Show this torrent in the torrent list

error.crawler_unavailable: Bitmagnet's TCP/IPv4 crawler is unavailable with the selected transport, encryption or bandwidth limits.
error.crawler_proxy_unavailable: No usable proxy address is available for Bitmagnet.
error.crawler_config_invalid: The Bitmagnet crawler configuration is invalid.
error.unknown: The operation could not be completed.
error.argument_exit: Use --exit without other options or torrents.
error.sources_limit:
Too many torrents, or their paths are too long.
Choose fewer torrents or shorter paths.
error.engine_running:
TinyTorrent is still running.
Finish any open prompt, then select Retry.
error.activation_refused:
TinyTorrent didn't accept the request.
Wait a moment, then select Retry.
error.invalid_destination: Choose an existing, writable download folder.
error.invalid_source: This isn't a valid magnet link or torrent file.
error.recovery_required: TinyTorrent couldn't confirm that the torrent was added. Check the torrent list before you try again.
error.invalid_priorities: Every file in this torrent matches the file name patterns that Settings skips.
error.torrent_removed: The torrent that this one matches was removed from the list.
error.torrent_removing: This torrent is still being removed. You can add it again when the removal has finished.
error.shared_files: Other torrents use these files. Refresh the list and include them in the move.
error.destination_conflict: These torrents would put different files at one path, or one file at two paths. Choose another folder or move these torrents separately.
error.destination_in_use: Another torrent uses files at this destination. Choose another folder to keep its files unchanged.
error.move_interrupted: The move was interrupted. Choose the folder that now holds the files and try Move again.
error.move_unfinished: This move stopped when TinyTorrent closed. It waits until you choose whether to continue unfinished tasks.
error.move_failed: The files could not be moved. They are still in their original folder.
error.destination_exists: A destination file has a different size. Both copies were kept.
error.same_location: The files are already there, under another path.
error.alias_conflict: Other torrents use these files with different names. Resolve the file names before continuing.
error.torrent_error: No further error details are available.
error.download_path_missing: The download path was not found.
error.download_path_unavailable: The drive or network share is not responding.
error.disk_full: There is no free space on the destination drive.
error.storage_failed: Saved download state could not be read or written. Check the engine data folder and try again.
error.storage_overloaded: TinyTorrent is busy saving download state. Try again shortly.
error.overloaded: TinyTorrent is busy. Try again shortly.
error.checkpoint_failed: The download state could not be saved. Check the engine data folder and try again.
error.watch_limit: This watched folder contains more than 10,000 torrent files. Remove old source files or choose a smaller folder.
error.version:
Another version of TinyTorrent is running.
Close it, then select Retry.
error.other_store: Another TinyTorrent uses a different data folder.
error.other_store_unidentified: Windows couldn't identify the other TinyTorrent. Exit it from its tray menu, then select Retry.
error.package:
TinyTorrent can't reach your torrents from this app.
Start TinyTorrent from the Start menu.
error.sandbox:
A sandbox keeps TinyTorrent from your torrents.
Start TinyTorrent from the Start menu.
error.source: The torrent could not be added.
error.ownership:
TinyTorrent can't open its saved data.
Another Windows sign-in may be using it.
error.launch: Windows could not start the window. TinyTorrent keeps running. The Windows error below explains why.
error.window_missing:
TinyTorrent's window program is missing from this folder. TinyTorrent keeps running.

Reinstall TinyTorrent to restore it.
error.window_denied:
Windows denied permission to start the window. TinyTorrent keeps running.

Check the window program's file permissions before trying again.
error.window_invalid:
Windows cannot run the window program on this PC. TinyTorrent keeps running.

Reinstall the version of TinyTorrent that matches your PC.
error.window_dependency:
A file required by the window program is missing. TinyTorrent keeps running.

Reinstall TinyTorrent to restore the required files.
error.startup: The window did not open. TinyTorrent keeps running.
error.save: TinyTorrent keeps trying and exits by itself once saving works. Force exit closes it now and loses the changes since the last save. Downloaded files stay on disk.
error.pause: The transfer pause setting could not be saved.
error.notification: The notification setting could not be saved.
error.window_open:
The TinyTorrent window is still open.
Close it, then select Retry.
error.unresponsive: The window did not respond to Exit. Nothing was discarded. Try Exit again when the window responds.
